items.title: Civilization 7
items.desc: General repository covering the Civilization 7 exploit.

items.title: Civilization 7 — CivSwitch Kit (FS Escalation)
items.desc: FS escalation path for Civilization 7 that provides arbitrary filesystem read/write and includes an example firmware dump of 90 system programs (222 MB).
items.notes: Requires Switch 2 firmware 23.0.1, the Switch 1 physical cartridge version 1.0.0, a one-time homebrew install from a modded Switch 1, and a Windows PC with Node.js 20+ and Python 3.10+ wired to the same LAN. Early-stage development with roughly a 30% success rate per boot.

items.title: Civilization 7 — Rooted Android
items.desc: If you have a rooted Android phone, you can do it all from the phone.

items.title: Civilization 7 — Modded Switch 1 (Two Carts)
items.desc: If you have a modded Switch 1 and two Civilization 7 carts, you can use this.

items.title: Civilization 7 — Linux + Modded Switch 1
items.desc: If you have a Linux system and a modded Switch 1, you can use this method, which is faster.

items.title: Civilization 7 — Modded Switch 1 (LDN)
items.desc: The LDN method without Linux: it only requires a modded Switch 1.

items.title: Civilization 7 — ESP32 + Modded Switch 1
items.desc: If you have an ESP32 and a modded Switch 1, this is the ESP port, which is also faster than the Pico / rooted Android method.

items.title: Civilization 7 — CivHomebrew
items.desc: Homebrew launcher for Switch and Switch 2 built on CivSwitch. Browse apps, install .civapp packages over FTP, and launch them from the console, with a built-in terminal for the original JavaScript payload workflow.
items.notes: Requires the Switch 1 edition of Civilization VII, physical cartridge version 1.0.0, and an existing CivSwitch setup.

items.title: Civilization 7 — Moonlight for CivSwitch
items.desc: Experimental Moonlight client running inside CivSwitch, letting you stream PC games to Switch 2 through Sunshine with a game library, controller input, video, and stereo audio.
items.notes: Requires the Switch 1 edition of Civilization VII, physical cartridge version 1.0.0, and CivSwitch already set up.

items.title: Civilization 7 — Jellyfin for CivHomebrew
items.desc: Unofficial Jellyfin client running inside CivHomebrew. Browse your libraries and watch media in fullscreen with controller support, using server-side transcoding and the console's native H.264/Opus player.
items.notes: Requires an existing CivHomebrew environment. Supports HTTP only (no HTTPS), so use a trusted local network or VPN. Saved credentials are stored unencrypted in the game save if enabled.

items.title: Artemis Engine games (Seedsow, Nora, Hamidashi)
items.desc: Supports the demos of Seedsow Lullaby, Nora, Princess and Crying Cat 2, and Hamidashi Creative.

items.notes: This is the original implementation of the exploit, and a lot of things have improved since then. It is better to try other implementations, such as the Firmware Dumping one, which offers the same features through the RPC server with much better results overall.

items.title: 90DNS
items.desc: Public DNS service that blocks (hopefully) all Nintendo servers to help prevent bans. Works on Switch 1 and Switch 2.
items.notes: Blocks the eShop, system updates, telemetry, social features and online play. Not guaranteed to prevent bans, so read the repository carefully before relying on it.
